_doc: Black-market supplier network (SupplierManager). Categories describe what is sold and the risk you're told about; grades set condition range and performance; suppliers are original contacts you discover through customers, staff, fixers, factions, quests and rumours. Per supplier: trust (unlocks), suspicion (too much and they cut you off), debt (credit: pay after N jobs), favours (requests through COMMS). Inventory refreshes daily and bends with time of day, district, heat, world events, your reputation and what you bought.

stolen.label: STOLEN
stolen.risk: May still be tracked by its owner. Heat +4 on purchase.

military_surplus.label: MILITARY SURPLUS
military_surplus.risk: Hard-wearing, unregistered, attracts corporate security. Heat +5.

experimental.label: EXPERIMENTAL
experimental.risk: Untested. Powerful or unstable; hidden properties likely.

restricted_equipment.label: RESTRICTED EQUIPMENT
restricted_equipment.risk: Licensed surgical tools you aren't licensed for. Heat +3.

illegal_pharma.label: ILLEGAL PHARMACEUTICALS
illegal_pharma.risk: Cheap sterile packs and stims, cut with who knows what. Heat +1.

counterfeit.label: COUNTERFEIT
counterfeit.risk: Brand-name shell, gutter internals. Often has a hidden flaw.

salvaged.label: SALVAGED
salvaged.risk: Pulled from the dead. Worn, cheap, honest about it.

prototype.label: PROTOTYPE
prototype.risk: Pre-release corporate chrome. Somebody will want it back. Heat +6.

rare_tools.label: RARE TOOLS
rare_tools.risk: Top-tier instruments off the books. Heat +2.

unknown_tech.label: UNKNOWN TECH
unknown_tech.risk: Unidentified device. Model, condition and properties unknown until analysed.

unlocks.label: Credit: pay after your next 3 jobs

suppliers.name: Magpie
suppliers.desc: Picks through crash sites and morgues. Talks too much, sells cheap.
suppliers.lead: A scavenger called Magpie sells what she pulls off the dead, under the Kessler overpass.

suppliers.name: Sergeant Okafor
suppliers.desc: Quartermaster who never stopped requisitioning. Wants discretion, pays in loyalty.
suppliers.lead: A quartermaster called Okafor moves crates out of the old Aegis depot. Mercs know how to reach him.

suppliers.name: Glass
suppliers.desc: Someone inside Lyra with a gambling problem. Never the same voice twice.
suppliers.lead: There's a leak inside Lyra Biocomp who goes by 'Glass'. Corporate clients sometimes know the drop.

suppliers.name: Sallow
suppliers.desc: Stims, sedatives, sterile packs of questionable origin. Always around, always cheap.
suppliers.lead: Sallow deals stims out of a noodle bar on Canal Street. Everybody knows Sallow.

suppliers.name: The Curator
suppliers.desc: Collects things nobody can identify. Pays well for mysteries, asks favours for the rest.
suppliers.lead: The Curator buys and sells chrome nobody can name. Your black-market contacts can make an introduction.

suppliers.name: Juno Pell
suppliers.desc: Knows everyone, owns nothing, takes ten percent of everything.
suppliers.lead: Juno Pell fixes deals for the whole lower city. Fixers who come through your door know the number.

favors.label: Treat someone of theirs
favors.body: {supplier}: "One of mine got cut. No records, no questions. You'll see them tomorrow."

favors.label: Hide a patient
favors.body: {supplier}: "I need someone kept in your back room for two nights. Security is looking."

favors.label: Deliver a package
favors.body: {supplier}: "Take a box across the canal for me. Don't open it."

favors.label: Store contraband
favors.body: {supplier}: "Keep a crate in your stash for a few days. If anyone asks, it's medical waste."

favors.label: Repair something (3 parts)
favors.body: {supplier}: "My arm's grinding. Fix it and we're square."

favors.label: Keep a secret
favors.body: {supplier}: "You saw a face last night you weren't meant to. You didn't see it. Right?"
